authorship: Root module independently reviewed; reviewer authored imported DispatchTerminal helper, independently reviewed by root.

validation.basis: Root collected actual target exit 0; reviewer inspected three clean standard-only axiom prints, not merely batch shell status.

findings: terminal extracts the successful running prefix and literal final dispatch from the SAME actual eval result. DispatchTerminal recovers the same checked terminal.run and actual referenceDecode some terminal, excluding fallback.

STOP/RETURN/REVERT use CheckedCompletion with the same prefix, terminal result, initial storage/owner/warm bindings and source grant. Replayed retains exact output and view observations while using synthetic old execution gas; REVERT observation is internal.
transaction_terminal derives the 30M domain from EntryAt at literal transaction allocation through transaction_entry. It does not assume selected append cost, old success, or a desired final state.

final_site_or_eof extracts SourceRun/payment from the same checked Run, derives its work bound, replays from initialized context, transports exact code/PC, then uses fixed-image site coverage or code-end lookup. It retains EOF explicitly and excludes invalid/unsupported at that final state.
open_boundaries: terminal is conditional on an actual terminal eval outcome; it does not prove all evaluated frames terminate successfully. Evaluator.completes may return failed/EOF/unsupported.
The initialized parent storage, owner and warmth remain explicit source-context bindings; ownerExists and destination context still require actual-source extraction.
EntryAt is a numerical resource relation, not unique occurrence identity or linkage of this evaluator to a selected source subtree.
No source gas equals synthetic gas, no source PC equals old terminal PC, no outer REVERT commit, no source journal/canonical history closure.
final_site_or_eof has an initial grant bound and context premises and does not establish noEOF.
